cause_quote: The early-listener change added `if (probeKind === "outside") { await opts.waitForRequestRuntime?.(); }` before Control UI routing, making the app document and static assets wait for runtime readiness.
user_saw: Opening the Control UI while the Gateway was starting could leave the browser waiting without showing startup progress.
summary: The fix serves the Control UI during Gateway startup and drain, adds an automatically retrying fallback page, and keeps open conversations and drafts mounted during automatic reconnects.
reasoning: The early-listener commit introduced both the interval in which HTTP could accept requests before runtime readiness and the wait that blocked Control UI documents and assets during that interval. I verified that the wait remained ahead of Control UI routing immediately before the fix and that the new HTTP test requires the app and assets to load while the readiness promise is still pending. The Solid migration carried forward the earlier cold-start sign-in logic, so the cause here is the fresh-visit startup failure.
